proposal.reason: Main change removes CollNet execution and connection paths from transport (deleted CollNet transport implementation, connection APIs, channel peer/root handling). Also requires network for CollNet plugin-loading removal while keeping Net v4/v5/v6, graph-search and device-topology for removing CollNet graph construction/search and NIC CollNet metadata paths, enqueue and tuning for disabling reserved algorithm slot 2 in runtime planning/selection with tuner fallback guards, and kernels for removing CollNet device kernel specializations while preserving table indices via reserved null entries.
